ns2:course.label: Optical Imaging
ns2:course.description: Introduction to scalar fields, geometrical optics, wave optics, gaussian beams, Fourier optics, spatial and temporal coherence, microscopy, interference chromatic and geometric aberrations, Jones matrices, waveplates, electromagnetic fields, electro-optic and acousto-optic effects; laboratory covers numerical signal processing, spectroscopy, ray optics, diffraction, Fourier optics, microscopy, spatial coherence, temporal coherence, polarimetry, fiber optics, electro-optic modulation and acousto-optic modulation. Prerequisite: ECE 329; credit or concurrent registration in ECE 313.
